title: Initial Detection
description: Unusual cluster of febrile illness reported in Cairo. Early samples submitted to national reference lab.

title: Lab Confirmation
description: National reference laboratory confirms novel pathogen. WHO notified under IHR (2005).

title: WHO PHEIC Declared
description: World Health Organization convenes Emergency Committee. Public Health Emergency of International Concern declared.

title: Regional Spread Confirmed
description: Cases confirmed in Khartoum following travel from Egypt. Cross-border transmission chain established.

title: International Response Activated
description: WHO Emergency Operations Centre activated. Three bilateral response teams mobilised.

title: 3rd Country Affected
description: Cluster detected in Addis Ababa. Contact tracing links to returning travellers from Egypt.

title: Nairobi Cluster
description: Cases at Nairobi transit hub. Airport screening protocols elevated to enhanced level.

title: 1,000 Confirmed Cases
description: Global cumulative confirmed cases surpass 1,000. Egypt accounts for 68% of total.

title: Supply Chain Disruption
description: Logistical constraints delay medical supply shipments to Khartoum field sites.

title: 5,000 Confirmed Cases
description: Cumulative cases reach 5,000. Weekly incidence rate accelerating; R estimated at 1.18.

title: Vaccine Candidate Fast-Track
description: WHO grants fast-track designation to lead vaccine candidate. Phase II trials begin in Cairo.

title: Khartoum System Overload
description: Khartoum health system capacity declared overwhelmed. Emergency field hospitals deployed.

title: R Exceeds 1.3
description: Latest epidemiological modelling places reproduction number at 1.31, above containment threshold.

title: Current Status
description: 8,420 confirmed cases across 17 active zones in 8 countries. Situation remains highly dynamic.
